The '''Phelar University Archive''' was a vast collection of artifacts located on the [[Phelar University]] campus. Only accredited [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] could enter the Archive, and all those who did received an orientation from [[Eren Garai]], an undercover [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent who searched for "subversive" activity on the university's campus.<ref name="FDCR" />

The Archive was located in the newest of Phelar University's buildings, a tower that some considered to be ugly. They covered over one hundred stories.<ref name="FDCR" />
